# komodo_api_key (Resource)

Manages an API key for a Komodo service user. The secret is only available at creation time and is stored in Terraform state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name for the API key. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the service user to create the API key for. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier (same as the key value).
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The API key value (K-...). Sensitive.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The API secret value (S-...). Only available at creation time. Sensitive.
